title: Join costing engine, screens and atomic settings save
public_pr_body:
Joins #110's price engine and #123's live screen wiring on the costing base, retaining the reviewed atomic-save client/proposal from #155. Machine labour overrides (including zero) survive display, saving and pricing; fractional pennies are refused before any request. Saving uses one RPC with no partial-write fallback. The proposal is included for review and has NOT been applied anywhere; settings cannot save until its separately reviewed deployment.

All 60 frozen golden prices run and pass. Focused costing suite: 627 passed, zero skipped, including 412 Python rounding comparisons. Exposing the rounding helper uncovered a large-value double-rounding defect; conversion now rounds once from the exact integer decimal. Existing UI assertions retain their checks with the newer plain-language labels. TypeScript passed; full suite/lint verification in progress.

Failed-save client tests assert no fallback writes and unchanged saved/draft objects. These do not prove database rollback: proposal execution is prohibited in this task. No docs files, Ready label, migration application, merge or deployment.
